title: Audit, rizik i ugovori
summary: Interni i eksterni audit, ISMS i politike, izazovi assurancea u cloudu, SOC 1/2/3 i Type I/II (SSAE 18, ISAE 3402), ograničenja obima, gap analiza i planiranje audita, regulisane industrije (NERC CIP, HIPAA/HITECH, PCI DSS), ERM i uloge nad podacima, tretman i metrike rizika, te ugovori (MSA, SOW, SLA), upravljanje dobavljačima i lanac snabdijevanja (ISO/IEC 27036).
summary_en: Internal and external audit, ISMS and policies, assurance challenges in the cloud, SOC 1/2/3 and Type I/II (SSAE 18, ISAE 3402), scope restrictions, gap analysis and audit planning, regulated industries (NERC CIP, HIPAA/HITECH, PCI DSS), ERM and data roles, risk treatment and metrics, and contracts (MSA, SOW, SLA), vendor management, and the supply chain (ISO/IEC 27036).
